lastCommit.subject: Build the booking status screen: all eleven states

current.summary: Read the design properly and repaired everything built on a partial reading of it. Five rounds of user pushback, each correct: the design project was reachable all along; only one canvas of five had been read; docs must precede Dart; wrong documentation is an emergency because everything downstream inherits it; and the flattener was stripping <script>, which is where the design keeps PAL, CATS, REQUIREMENTS and all eleven BSTATES. Brand imported and shipped - launcher, adaptive, splash and notification icons all real and verified on device. Colour and type verified against the canvas rather than assumed. Booking status built with all eleven states.
current.state: Brand real and on device; colour and type verified against PAL; entry flow built; booking status built with 11 states; four brand cuts still over the fetch cap; no backend; nothing persists
decisions: Brand is Phase 1, because the design's Foundations runs Brand then Colour then Type then Components before any screen. It had been bolted on as Phase 0.5
DISPUTED and NO_SHOW ship with the design's own provisional notes rather than being withheld - the design wrote the copy and flagged it itself
Never recolour the brand artwork: light and dark are separate drawings, the dark cut has a white i body, and a ColorFilter flattens the ripple rings and both blues
The dark splash uses the design's dark app icon on a background matching its baked navy plate, which is why it works without mark-dark.png
PromiseCard.iconColor is required - two artboards use different greens on the same glyph and a default would silently make one wrong
Docs are corrected before Dart, and Dart follows the docs rather than the reverse
working: Launcher icon at five densities, adaptive icon with a monochrome layer, splash icon in both modes, notification icon wired into the manifest - all verified on a Pixel 9a
Colour verified against the canvas PAL: every token matches exactly in both modes, including all six shadow alphas
Type verified: all eight roles match the canvas scale
Booking status with all eleven states, copy verbatim from BSTATES, payment at step 4, endings hiding the step bar
Entry flow: splash, register, sign in, OTP with wrong-code and locked states, consent, biometric enrolment, unlock, location, auth gate
notWorking: Four brand cuts exceed the 256 KiB fetch cap - mark-dark, wordmark-dark-new, lockup-dark, logo-light-transparent. The in-app splash still sets the wordmark in type
Phase 2 is half done: booking status is built, booking request and rate & review are not
The OTP screen has its states but no backend - DemoOtpVerifier accepts any four digits
Consent supersede is modelled and still not enforced by a router redirect
local_auth is not wired; both unlock buttons call unlock()
iOS is stock and cannot be built on this machine
doNotRepeat: Stripping <script> when flattening a canvas - that is 16673 characters per file holding PAL, CATS, REQUIREMENTS, the pricing copy and all eleven BSTATES

Transcribing a binary out of a tool result. mark-icon.png came back complete and inline and was still corrupt from a hand copy; Image.open read the header fine and only a full load() failed. Decode from the file the tool wrote and verify the IEND chunk before it lands

Get-Content / Set-Content on a source file - they default to the system codepage. A one-symbol rename double-encoded nine em dashes and a middot; it compiled and all tests passed, and was only visible as mojibake in a screenshot
Writing a mojibake detector with the mangled characters written out literally - it matches itself. Build the pattern from \u escapes
Reading a canvas name as one of ours: pal.shCard is our shadowRow, pal.shRaise is our shadowCard
CrossAxisAlignment.stretch on a Row inside a ListView - unbounded constraint, will not lay out. Use IntrinsicHeight
A modal on a tab's Navigator - go_router re-syncs on pop and removes the page underneath
A PowerShell here-string or heredoc for git commit -m. Write the message to a file and use git commit -F
nextSteps: Finish Phase 2: booking request and rate & review, both in ds-2-customer. The direction radio set and pricing copy are already in the canvas script block
Phase 3: the loop prompt, stage 7. Suppression rules are in foundations - adjacent category thin, already booked, or the same person
When the four cuts arrive: drop them into design/assets/, point BrandLockup(onDark:) at the real artwork, delete the type fallback
Close Phase 1's remainder: local_auth, the consent-supersede redirect, persistence for SessionController
Read docs/build-order.md first - it carries a 60-artboard index so each phase points at the screen it implements
blockers: BLOCKING, only the user can clear it: mark-dark, wordmark-dark-new, lockup-dark and logo-light-transparent all exceed the 256 KiB get_file cap. Re-save them smaller in the design project or export directly
Undesigned so not startable: the dispute FLOW (UC-13), customer-provider messaging, provider listing management at scale, empty and offline states
Late-cancellation fee amount - percentage, flat, or first-occurrence waiver
Commission rate per category - rides shows 8%
Dispute turnaround - screens promise contact but name no timeframe
Carried: reversal policy, negative balance, min top-up, hosting durability, EPS licensing, data residency, KYC retention, GPS DPIA
Noted not fixed: the design numbers two screens 21, and Session.maxCodeAttempts (5) is the repo's number - the design says 'locked after N attempts' without setting N

archive.summary: Followed docs/build-order.md rather than re-deriving it. Closed Phase 0 by running all five built screens on a Pixel 9a in both modes - the first time this app has been seen rendered. The palette came back exact; the supply count was ellipsised and is fixed. The run exposed that the app has no identity at all, raised by the user mid-session: stock Flutter icon, white cold-start flash, no mark. Fixed what needed no artwork, made the rest an enforced artifact. Then built Phase 1 in full: seven entry routes plus the auth gate, with the entry rules held as states in core/session.dart. 147 tests.
